title: Quick and Crispy Russian Vegetables Fritters
description: A flavorful, crispy, and quick-fix Russian dish featuring sautéed vegetables, plant-based-friendly, and a sweet surprise from raspberry jam.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the grated carrots and zucchini, cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, bread crumbs, egg replacement, water, salt, and black pepper.
Gently add the cooked vegetables to the bowl and mix until combined.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the same pan over medium-high heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the vegetable mixture into the pan.
Press the mixture down to form a flat patty.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Serve the fritters hot with a dollop of raspberry jam.
Garnish with additional chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
